verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an online government filing service like Corporations Canada, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, chatbot or agentic delegation inside the product. The pack covers only the Online Filing Centre, PDF forms and email notices, and the probe notes that no transactional API is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
